zh.headline: 美国政府对 Anthropic 模型实施出口管制，Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 被强制下架
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号有三点：第一，美国政府对 Anthropic 的出口管制引发了关于"谁来决定 AI 是否危险"的激烈争论，这将成为未来 AI 全球治理的分水岭事件；第二，GLM-5.2 的 MIT 开源标志着开源模型首次在综合能力上全面超越同级闭源模型，AI 经济正在向开源倾斜；第三，LangGraph 等 agent 框架的安全漏洞暴露了 AI agent 在生产部署中的系统性风险，安全性正在成为 agent 落地的首要障碍。整体来看，AI 产业正在从"能力竞赛"转向"安全与成本竞赛"。

items.title: 美国政府对 Anthropic 模型实施出口管制，Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 被强制下架
items.desc: 特朗普政府以国家安全为由，强制 Anthropic 下线其最新模型 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5，理由是其护栏被绕过。该禁令引发安全界强烈反弹，Anthropic 指出其他模型也存在同样漏洞。
items.value: AI 出口管制政策走向对全球模型分发格局产生深远影响

items.title: OpenAI 提升 ChatGPT 医疗健康能力，GPT-5.5 Instant 在多项指标上超越医生
items.desc: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.5 Instant 在准确性、清晰度和完整性上超越医生撰写的回答，健康相关错误率下降 71%，并发布 LifeSciBench 基准。
items.value: AI 在医疗领域的可信度实现关键突破

items.title: Nobel 奖得主 John Jumper 离开 Google DeepMind 加入 Anthropic
items.desc: AlphaFold 核心开发者、Nobel 化学奖得主 John Jumper 在任职近九年后离开 Google DeepMind 加入 Anthropic，标志着 Google 顶尖 AI 人才的持续流失。
items.value: 顶级人才流向反映 AI 竞争格局变化

items.title: OpenAI IPO 前大规模招兵买马，Transformer 共同发明人 Noam Shazeer 加入
items.desc: OpenAI 在 IPO 前夕从 Google DeepMind 挖来 Transformer 共同发明人 Noam Shazeer，并聘用前特朗普 AI 政策官员 Dean Ball。
items.value: OpenAI 上市前强化核心团队，信号强烈

items.title: Langflow、LangGraph 和 LangChain 框架存在严重安全漏洞，7000 台服务器遭攻击
items.desc: Check Point Research 发现 LangGraph 的 SQLite checkpointer 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，影响广泛部署的 AI agent 框架。
items.value: AI agent 框架安全性成为生产部署的关键瓶颈

items.title: 企业因成本压力收紧 AI 使用
items.desc: 多家企业因 AI 预算超支而缩减 AI 项目投入，成本问题成为 AI 落地的现实障碍。
items.value: AI 投资回报率成为企业决策核心考量

items.title: 挪威禁止小学使用生成式 AI 工具
items.desc: 挪威政府宣布从 8 月底起，小学 1-7 年级学生不得使用 AI 工具，中学仅在监督下允许使用，以保护基础学习能力。
items.value: 全球 AI 教育监管走向收紧的信号

items.title: Snap 因成本原因将 AI 视频团队剥离为独立公司 Dotmo
items.desc: Snapchat 母公司 Snap 将其 AI 视频开发团队剥离为新公司 Dotmo，由现有员工组成，专注 AI 视频开发。
items.value: AI 子公司分拆成为大厂降本增效的新模式

items.title: AI 推理初创公司 Baseten 据报道在上一轮融资数月后再筹 15 亿美元
items.desc: Baseten 据称接近完成 15 亿美元融资，估值达 130 亿美元，AI 推理"淘金热"持续升温。
items.value: AI 推理基础设施赛道持续吸引巨额资本

items.title: Adobe 将 Agentic AI 工作流嵌入 Creative Cloud，从媒体生成转向制作编排
items.desc: Adobe 在 Photoshop、Premiere Pro 等应用中推出 AI 助手，作为编排层而非简单的生成工具，支持实时协作。
items.value: AI 从内容生成向工作流编排演进的重要标志

items.title: Google 因 AI 搜索结果错误被德国法院判定直接责任，提出上诉
items.desc: 慕尼黑地区法院裁定 Google 对 AI 生成的搜索摘要内容承担直接责任，AI 错误地将两家慕尼黑出版商与欺诈计划关联。
items.value: AI 生成内容的法律责任边界首次被明确划定

items.title: AWS 推出 Context 知识图谱服务，进入 AI agent 上下文层竞争
items.desc: AWS 发布 Context 服务，通过 agent 使用自动优化知识图谱，无需手动策划，旨在标准化企业 AI 的上下文层。
items.value: 云计算巨头争夺 AI 基础设施的关键拼图

items.title: OpenAI 发布 LifeSciBench：750 个任务的 AI 生命科学研究基准
items.desc: 由 173 位博士科学家构建，包含 19020 条评分标准，评估 AI 在真实生命科学研究中的推理和决策能力。最佳模型 GPT-Rosalind 仅通过 36.1%。
items.value: 首个专家级生命科学 AI 评估基准，挑战巨大

items.title: OpenAI 提出"有益特质训练"：少量 RL 训练即可使 AI 模型更安全、更难操纵
items.desc: 通过在真实性、可纠正性等特质上进行强化学习，模型在 53 个基准中的 44 个上表现更好，且跨领域泛化。
items.value: 提供一种轻量级、可扩展的 AI 安全训练方法

items.title: HumanScale：第一人称人类视频在具身预训练中优于真实机器人数据
items.desc: 研究表明，通过第一人称人类视频训练的模型在具身任务上表现优于使用遥操作机器人数据训练的模型，且数据获取成本更低。
items.value: 为具身 AI 的数据瓶颈提供可扩展的解决方案

items.title: FAPO：多步 LLM 管道的全自动提示优化框架
items.desc: FAPO 让 Claude Code 在标准化代码库中自动优化 LLM 管道，通过评估、检查中间步骤、诊断失败、提出范围变更并迭代验证来优化。
items.value: 实现 LLM 管道优化的完全自动化

items.title: SSD：空间推测解码加速自回归图像生成
items.desc: 提出利用图像 2D 空间局部性的推测解码框架，同时预测空间相邻的多个 token，显著加速自回归图像生成。
items.value: 将推测解码从语言扩展到视觉生成领域

items.title: ContextRL：面向 Agentic 和多模态 LLM 的上下文感知强化学习
items.desc: 提出间接辅助目标方法，不仅监督最终答案，还监督推理过程，改善长程推理和多模态性能。
items.value: 解决 LLM 在长上下文中的关键证据识别难题

items.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA)：109B MoE 模型上的两分支块稀疏注意力
items.desc: 通过轻量级索引分支选择 Top-k KV 块，主分支仅关注这些块，在 1M 上下文下将每 token 注意力计算减少 28.4 倍。
items.value: 超长上下文推理成本降低的重要实践

items.title: NVIDIA SpatialClaw：将代码作为空间推理动作接口的无训练 agent
items.desc: SpatialClaw 在持久内核中编写 Python，组合感知工具进行 3D 空间推理，无需训练即可实现零样本泛化。
items.value: 代码即动作接口，为空间推理 agent 提供新范式

items.title: GLM-5.2 正式开源：MIT 许可证下最强的文本开放权重模型
items.desc: Z.ai 发布 753B 参数 MoE 模型（40B 激活参数），支持 1M token 上下文，在多个基准上超越 GPT-5.5。现已支持本地运行（2-bit 量化 238GB）。
items.value: 开源模型首次在综合能力上超越同级闭源模型

items.title: VibeThinker-3B：3B 参数密集推理模型，匹配 DeepSeek V3.2 和 Kimi K2.5
items.desc: 基于 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 构建，采用 Spectrum-to-Signal 后训练流程，MIT 许可证发布，在可验证基准上表现与更大模型相当。
items.value: 小参数模型实现大模型级别推理能力的新路径

items.title: Vercel 开源 Eve：AI agent 框架，每个 agent 是一个目录文件
items.desc: Apache-2.0 许可，支持持久化执行、沙箱、审批、连接、渠道和评估，可通过 `npx eve@latest init` 快速搭建。
items.value: 文件即 agent 的极简设计，降低 agent 开发门槛

items.title: QUEST-35B：32 张 H100 训练的开源 Deep Research agent
items.desc: 俄亥俄州立大学 NLP 团队开源 Deep Research agent，使用约 32 张 H100 和约 8000 个合成样本训练，开源训练配方、代码、权重和数据集。
items.value: 证明低资源下也能训练出可用的 Deep Research agent

items.title: Perplexity 发布 Brain：agent 自改进记忆系统
items.desc: Brain 为 Perplexity 的 Computer agent 构建可追溯的上下文图，夜间自动审查学习，在正确性、召回率和成本上均有提升。
items.value: agent 长期记忆和自改进的新方案

items.title: Liquid AI 发布 LFM2.5 嵌入模型：面向多语言搜索的边缘设备方案
items.desc: 推出 LFM2.5-Embedding-350M 和 LFM2.5-ColBERT-350M，支持 11 种语言的多语言搜索，可在边缘设备上运行。
items.value: 边缘设备多语言搜索的实用方案

en.headline: US Government Imposes Export Controls on Anthropic Models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Forced Offline
en.observation: Three signals stand out today. First, the US government's export controls on Anthropic have ignited a fierce debate over "who decides when AI is too dangerous," which will become a watershed event for global AI governance. Second, GLM-5.2's MIT open-source release marks the first time an open-source model comprehensively surpasses comparable closed-source models, with AI economics shifting toward open models. Third, security vulnerabilities in agent frameworks like LangGraph expose systemic risks in production AI agent deployment, with security becoming the primary barrier to agent adoption. Overall, the AI industry is shifting from a "capability race" to a "safety and cost race."

items.title: US Government Imposes Export Controls on Anthropic Models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Forced Offline
items.desc: The Trump administration ordered Anthropic to take down its latest models Fable 5 and Mythos 5 citing national security concerns after guardrails were bypassed. The ban sparked backlash from security researchers, with Anthropic noting the same jailbreaks exist in other models.
items.value: AI export control policy will reshape global model distribution landscape

items.title: OpenAI Upgrades ChatGPT Health Intelligence, GPT-5.5 Instant Beats Doctor-Written Answers
items.desc: OpenAI announced GPT-5.5 Instant surpasses doctor-written responses in accuracy, clarity, and completeness, with a 71% reduction in health-related error rates, and released the LifeSciBench benchmark.
items.value: AI credibility in healthcare achieves a critical breakthrough

items.title: Nobel Laureate John Jumper Leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic
items.desc: The core developer of AlphaFold and Nobel Chemistry Prize winner John Jumper left Google DeepMind after nearly nine years to join Anthropic, marking continued brain drain of top AI talent from Google.
items.value: Top talent flows reflect shifting AI competitive landscape

items.title: OpenAI Beefs Up Team Ahead of IPO, Lands Transformer Co-Inventor Noam Shazeer
items.desc: OpenAI poached Transformer co-inventor Noam Shazeer from Google DeepMind and hired former Trump AI policy official Dean Ball ahead of its IPO.
items.value: OpenAI strengthens core team pre-IPO, a strong signal

items.title: Critical Security Vulnerabilities Found in Langflow, LangGraph, and LangChain Frameworks, 7,000 Servers Under Attack
items.desc: Check Point Research discovered a SQL injection vulnerability in LangGraph's SQLite checkpointer enabling full remote code execution, affecting widely deployed AI agent frameworks.
items.value: AI agent framework security becomes key production deployment bottleneck

items.title: Companies Rein in AI Usage as Costs Strain Budgets
items.desc: Multiple enterprises are scaling back AI projects due to budget overruns, with cost becoming a real barrier to AI deployment.
items.value: AI ROI becomes core consideration for enterprise decisions

items.title: Norway Bans Generative AI Tools in Elementary Schools
items.desc: The Norwegian government announced that from late August, students in grades 1-7 cannot use AI tools, and secondary schools only under supervision, to protect basic learning skills.
items.value: Signal of tightening global AI education regulation

items.title: Snap Spins Off AI Video Team into New Company Dotmo Due to Costs
items.desc: Snapchat parent company Snap is spinning off its AI video development team into a new company called Dotmo, composed of current staff focusing on AI video development.
items.value: AI subsidiary spin-offs become new model for cost efficiency

items.title: AI Inference Startup Baseten Reportedly Raising $1.5B Months After Last Mega-Round
items.desc: Baseten is reportedly close to finalizing a $1.5 billion round at a $13 billion valuation as the AI inference "gold rush" continues.
items.value: AI inference infrastructure continues attracting massive capital

items.title: Adobe Embeds Agentic AI Workflows Across Creative Cloud, Shifting from Media Generation to Production Orchestration
items.desc: Adobe launches AI assistants in Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and other apps as an orchestration layer rather than simple generation tools, supporting real-time collaboration.
items.value: Important milestone in AI evolution from content generation to workflow orchestration

items.title: Google Appeals Ruling Making It Directly Liable for AI-Generated Search Overview Content
items.desc: The Munich Regional Court held Google directly liable for AI-generated search summary content, after the AI falsely linked two Munich-based publishers to fraud schemes.
items.value: Legal liability boundaries for AI-generated content clearly defined for the first time

items.title: AWS Enters Context Layer Race with Context Knowledge Graph Service
items.desc: AWS launched Context, a knowledge graph service that automatically optimizes through agent usage without manual curation, aiming to standardize the context layer for enterprise AI.
items.value: Cloud giant competes for a key piece of AI infrastructure

items.title: OpenAI Releases LifeSciBench: A 750-Task AI Life Science Research Benchmark
items.desc: Built by 173 PhD scientists with 19,020 rubric criteria, evaluating AI reasoning and decision-making in real life science research. Best model GPT-Rosalind only passes 36.1%.
items.value: First expert-level life science AI evaluation benchmark with huge headroom

items.title: OpenAI Proposes "Beneficial Trait Training": Small Doses of RL Make AI Models Safer and Harder to Manipulate
items.desc: Reinforcement learning on traits like truthfulness and corrigibility improved performance on 44 out of 53 benchmarks and generalized across domains.
items.value: Provides a lightweight, scalable AI safety training method

items.title: HumanScale: Egocentric Human Video Outperforms Real-Robot Data for Embodied Pretraining
items.desc: Research shows models trained on egocentric human video outperform those trained on teleoperated robot data for embodied tasks, with lower data collection costs.
items.value: Scalable solution to the data bottleneck in embodied AI

items.title: FAPO: Fully Autonomous Prompt Optimization Framework for Multi-Step LLM Pipelines
items.desc: FAPO lets Claude Code automatically optimize LLM pipelines within a standardized codebase by evaluating, inspecting intermediate steps, diagnosing failures, proposing changes, and iterating.
items.value: Enables fully automated LLM pipeline optimization

items.title: SSD: Spatially Speculative Decoding Accelerates Autoregressive Image Generation
items.desc: Proposes a speculative decoding framework leveraging 2D spatial locality of images, predicting multiple spatially adjacent tokens simultaneously to significantly accelerate autoregressive image generation.
items.value: Extends speculative decoding from language to visual generation

items.title: ContextRL: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
items.desc: Proposes an indirect auxiliary objective that supervises not only the final answer but also the reasoning process, improving long-horizon reasoning and multimodal performance.
items.value: Solves the key evidence identification problem in long-context LLMs

items.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA): Two-Branch Block-Sparse Attention on 109B MoE Model
items.desc: A lightweight Index Branch selects Top-k KV blocks, the Main Branch attends only to those blocks, reducing per-token attention compute by 28.4× at 1M context.
items.value: Important practice for reducing ultra-long context inference costs

items.title: NVIDIA SpatialClaw: Training-Free Agent Using Code as Action Interface for Spatial Reasoning
items.desc: SpatialClaw writes Python in a persistent kernel, composing perception tools for 3D spatial reasoning, achieving zero-shot generalization without training.
items.value: Code-as-action paradigm offers new approach for spatial reasoning agents

items.title: GLM-5.2 Open-Sourced: Strongest Text-Only Open Weights Model Under MIT License
items.desc: Z.ai released a 753B parameter MoE model (40B active parameters) supporting 1M token context, surpassing GPT-5.5 on multiple benchmarks. Now runs locally (2-bit quantized 238GB).
items.value: Open source model surpasses comparable closed-source models in comprehensive capability

items.title: VibeThinker-3B: 3B Parameter Dense Reasoning Model Matching DeepSeek V3.2 and Kimi K2.5
items.desc: Built on Qwen2.5-Coder-3B with Spectrum-to-Signal post-training pipeline, MIT-licensed, achieving performance comparable to much larger models on verifiable benchmarks.
items.value: New path to large-model-level reasoning capability with small parameters

items.title: Vercel Open-Sources Eve: AI Agent Framework Where Each Agent is a Directory of Files
items.desc: Apache-2.0 licensed, supporting durable execution, sandboxes, approvals, connections, channels, and evals. Scaffold with `npx eve@latest init`.
items.value: Minimalist file-as-agent design lowers agent development barrier

items.title: QUEST-35B: Open-Source Deep Research Agent Trained on 32 H100s
items.desc: Ohio State University NLP team open-sourced a Deep Research agent trained on ~32 H100s with ~8K synthetic samples, including training recipe, code, weights, and datasets.
items.value: Proves usable Deep Research agents can be trained with limited resources

items.title: Perplexity Launches Brain: Self-Improving Memory System for Agents
items.desc: Brain builds a traceable context graph for Perplexity's Computer agent, reviews and learns overnight, improving correctness, recall, and cost.
items.value: New approach to long-term memory and self-improvement for agents

items.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5 Embedding Models: Edge Device Solution for Multilingual Search
items.desc: LFM2.5-Embedding-350M and LFM2.5-ColBERT-350M support multilingual search across 11 languages and run on edge devices.
items.value: Practical solution for edge device multilingual search
